title: An understood attachment lets thought grow
meaning: Free comparison can make your shared view more fruitful by revealing attachment to an appealing explanation.
text: A shared thought can grow after recognising that a favourite version held it too tightly. The Lovers in the physical position of Ajna suggest comparing personal views freely. The Devil in energy supports constructive interest in an appealing explanation’s hold. The Empress in emotions enjoys understanding as it develops.

Suppose you plan a small gathering and think it must be unusual. Comparing wishes reveals interest in simple conversation repeatedly obscured by searching for an impressive idea. **Understanding attachment can give a living thought room to grow.** You see the demand’s appeal: surprising people promised a sense of a special event. Particular interest nevertheless already existed. An attractive image becomes distinguishable from both people’s actual wish. A thought finally finding room feels fruitful. Your view becomes useful as the intention develops through that distinction while each person keeps their own shade of the gathering.

The risk is making simplicity another compulsory model and treating every vivid idea as the earlier trap. A limit merely changes its name. Interest in explanations’ hold can reveal that transition. An unusual intention can express a wish or replace it. Your shared view becomes fruitful through considering the particular case. A living thought develops more freely while preserving pleasure in discovery and room to clarify what interests each person.
